stories.short: Anthropic set its IPO at $70 to $78 a share for 825 million shares, listing on Nasdaq as ANT. That raises up to about $64 billion and values the Claude maker at roughly $1.1 to $1.4 trillion. The BBC says shares list on 19 November; the FT says bankers may raise the price.

stories.title: US October CPI rises 0.4% m/m (forecast 0.3%; September 0.6%); a weak $42B 10-year auction clears at 5.020% as the 10-year yield tops 5%; a December Fed hike is fully priced and odds of 50bp rise to ~10% after Governor Waller backs bigger moves; Dallas Fed's Logan calls for two more 25bp hikes; gold falls 2.7% to ~$4,028
stories.short: US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than the 0.3% expected. The 10-year Treasury yield climbed above 5% after a weak auction, and markets now fully expect the Fed to raise rates in December. Fed officials Waller and Logan both backed more hikes. Gold fell nearly 3%.

stories.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model, generally available to paying developers and enterprises at Argon's introductory $2/$10 per million tokens and to AI Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app, Antigravity and AI Mode; Google says it ranks #1 on CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity's WANDR and Zapier's AutomationBench at over 2x lower cost per task than the next external model, and previews /swarm multi-agent teams in Antigravity
stories.short: Google opened Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model, to all paying developers at $2 per million input tokens and $10 output, a quarter of Fable 5.2's input price. Google says it ranks first on several agent benchmarks at half the cost per task, and is testing a /swarm feature for agent teams.

stories.title: Project Faro, a 21-bank consortium including Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, Santander, Deutsche Bank and BBVA, commits about $270M to cover five years of operations and targets a US-dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027, followed by a euro coin and eventually all G7 currencies (Bloomberg via Cointelegraph, CoinDesk)
stories.short: A group of 21 banks including Goldman Sachs, Citi, Santander, Deutsche Bank and BBVA has committed about $270 million to Project Faro, a joint company that plans to issue a US-dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027, then euro and other G7 currency coins, Bloomberg reports.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings (Claude joins video calls as a visible participant and works on tasks live), Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets in beta, and makes Claude Dashboards generally available as Claude Data, on all paid plans; partners include Lucid, Miro, Zoho Vani and Smartsheet
stories.short: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings, where Claude joins video calls and works on tasks while people talk, plus Claude Sheets and Whiteboards in beta and Claude Data for dashboards, on all paid plans. It puts Anthropic in direct competition with Microsoft and Google office software, days before its IPO.

stories.title: Leaked documents reported by the WSJ show OpenAI's Q3 revenue rose about 50% to ~$10B while its adjusted operating loss widened to about $10.9B; its adjusted operating margin improved from -150% in Q2 to -109%
stories.short: Leaked documents reported by the Wall Street Journal show OpenAI's revenue rose about 50% to roughly $10 billion last quarter, but its adjusted operating loss was about $10.9 billion. Its loss margin did narrow, from -150% to -109%. The figures land as Anthropic prices its IPO.

stories.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code, a multi-model agent framework, formally verifies key security properties of the actual Signal protocol implementation: agents running Gemini Carbon wrote over 6 million lines of Lean, flagging about 1% of the proof for human review; DeepMind says it is the first formal verification of a widely deployed protocol implementation by any method
stories.short: Google DeepMind says its AlphaProof Code agents mathematically proved key security properties of the real code behind the Signal protocol, writing over six million lines of Lean proofs. Humans reviewed only about 1%. DeepMind calls it the first formal verification of a widely deployed protocol's implementation.

stories.title: Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday fixes 1,093 vulnerabilities (63 critical, 535 privilege escalation), the second month above 1,000, including actively exploited Outlook spoofing bug CVE-2026-124194; Microsoft has shipped 5,100+ fixes this year and credits AI-driven discovery; Apple also ships out-of-band fixes for iMessage group-chat flaws (update to 27.2.1)
stories.short: Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday fixes 1,093 security bugs, 63 critical, including an Outlook spoofing flaw already used in attacks. It is the second month above 1,000 fixes, which Microsoft credits to AI finding bugs. Apple also patched iMessage flaws; update to version 27.2.1.

stories.title: Railway's incident report says attackers using AI agents escaped build isolation on 20 Oct, stole its source code and decrypted environment variables for up to 1.85% of workspaces (~100,000), and ran about $740K of fraudulent AI usage on stolen provider keys during a ~26-hour fight with its engineers
stories.short: Railway says attackers using AI agents broke out of its build system in October, stole its source code and decrypted secrets for up to 100,000 customer workspaces. Stolen AI keys were used for about $740,000 of fraudulent AI usage. Railway's engineers fought them for about 26 hours.

stories.title: The CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over failing to properly notify it of dozens of new contracts, a source tells Business Insider/Reuters; Kalshi calls it a procedural error over a handful of contracts, many never live; Kalshi is valued at $40B and Polymarket at $21B
stories.short: The US derivatives regulator has warned Kalshi it may soon face charges over failing to properly notify it about dozens of new betting contracts, sources say. Kalshi calls it a procedural error over a handful of contracts. Kalshi is valued at about $40 billion.

stories.title: TSMC will invest up to $1B in AI labs, $500M each in Anthropic and OpenAI, and sets up an investment firm to expand its semiconductor strategy (Economic Times, DigiTimes)
stories.short: TSMC, the world's main maker of AI chips, will invest up to $1 billion in AI labs, $500 million each in Anthropic and OpenAI, the Economic Times reports. It ties the chipmaker more closely to its biggest customers' customers, just as Anthropic starts its IPO roadshow.

stories.title: The Houthis launch another attack on pumping stations along Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, the route that lets Saudi crude bypass Hormuz; Brent nonetheless falls below $90 for the first time since August on Iran peace hopes, as US forces coordinate Saudi tanker crossings of Hormuz
stories.short: The Houthis attacked Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline again, the route that lets Saudi crude avoid Hormuz. Oil still fell: Brent dropped below $90 for the first time since August on hopes the US will not resume strikes on Iran, and Hormuz tanker traffic is recovering.

stories.title: Google DeepMind releases Gemini Robotics 2.5 to partners: a vision-language-action model it says is 30-100% better than its earlier baselines across 200+ tasks; Apptronik's Apollo 2 humanoid hit 96% success sorting metal parts on live Mercedes-Benz lines in Hungary and Germany; it also open-sources the ASIMOV-Jailbreak robot safety benchmark
stories.short: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, a model that controls robots from camera input and instructions. In a pilot on live Mercedes-Benz production lines, Apptronik's Apollo 2 humanoid sorted metal parts with 96% success. DeepMind also released an open benchmark for tricking robots into unsafe actions.

stories.title: Oura agrees to buy Counsel Health, a Boston AI medical-advice company with in-house virtual doctors, for $625M in cash, closing by year-end; members will go from a ring insight to Counsel's medical AI and a physician inside the Oura app; the deal follows Oura's postponed IPO
stories.short: Smart-ring maker Oura is buying Counsel Health, which combines a medical AI chatbot with its own virtual doctors, for $625 million in cash. Oura users will be able to go from a ring alert to AI advice and a doctor's visit in one app. The deal follows Oura's delayed IPO.

stories.title: Mercor raises $750M (Series D) at a $20B valuation to take its network of 5M+ domain experts from training frontier models to helping enterprises train and evaluate their own AI agents
stories.short: Mercor, which supplies human experts to train and test AI models, raised $750 million at a $20 billion valuation. It now wants to help ordinary companies check whether AI agents can be trusted with specific jobs, using its network of more than 5 million experts.

stories.title: AMD makes 6th Gen EPYC 'Venice' (Zen 6, TSMC N2P) server CPUs generally available, shipping from major OEMs with Azure and OCI instances, pitched for agent orchestration and sandboxes; reviews say the 9686F often beats Nvidia's Vera CPU and a dual 9996 is up to 93% faster than dual Zen 5
stories.short: AMD began shipping its 6th Gen EPYC Venice server processors, built on Zen 6 and pitched at running AI agents. Azure and Oracle Cloud will offer them. Reviews say a dual top-end system is up to 93% faster than the previous generation and often beats Nvidia's Vera CPU.

stories.title: Security firm Claroc finds Grok Build's app-sharing links can be enumerated, exposing thousands of live vibe-coded apps and their data, including business plans, medical results, employee IDs and 24 apps built by SpaceXSI itself (a confidential sales onboarding plan and a 594-account territory map)
stories.short: Researchers found that anyone could list thousands of apps built with SpaceXSI's Grok Build agent and read their data, including business plans, medical results and staff IDs. Twenty-four exposed apps belonged to SpaceXSI itself, including a confidential sales plan.

stories.title: Allstate CEO Tom Wilson says customers will get an Allstate personal agentic assistant (PAA) early in 2027, in development for over a year, and that Allstate is happy for customers' own AI agents to deal with it instead of agents or the website
stories.short: Allstate's CEO says customers will get an Allstate AI agent early in 2027, and that the insurer is happy to deal with customers' own AI agents instead of phone calls. That is the opposite stance from many banks, which are restricting customers' AI agents.

stories.title: The Pentagon's Office of Strategic Capital commits a $150M conditional loan to Rocket Lab (after $150M to Stoke Space on 26 Oct) to speed up new rockets, as SpaceX winds down Falcon 9 and officials worry about a launch supply crunch
stories.short: The Pentagon committed a $150 million loan to Rocket Lab, two weeks after a similar loan to Stoke Space, to speed up new rockets. Officials appear worried about relying on SpaceX as it retires the Falcon 9, which much of the US government and industry uses to reach orbit.

stories.title: SpaceX plans to invest about $24B in a natural-gas power plant and supercomputing facility at Starbase, Texas, per a public hearing notice reported by Bloomberg and DigiTimes
stories.short: SpaceX plans to spend about $24 billion on a gas-fired power plant and AI supercomputer at its Starbase site in Texas, Bloomberg and DigiTimes report, citing a public hearing notice. AI companies are increasingly building their own power plants instead of waiting for the grid.

stories.title: Japanese furniture retailer Nitori says an attacker accessed a system from mid-October until 6 Nov and may have stolen up to 37.62 million customer records covering store and online shoppers
stories.short: Japanese furniture retailer Nitori, which runs nearly 1,100 stores across Asia, says a hacker had access to one of its systems from mid-October until 6 November and may have stolen up to 37.6 million customer records from store and online shoppers.
